instruction.text: Sarah is a marine biologist working on a submarine. She travels to different depths to study the wildlife there. Decide if the following statements are true or false.

atoms.a: The submarine starts at −50 metres and then rises 15 metres. What depth is it at now?

The submarine starts at −53 metres and then rises 4 metres. What depth is it at now?
